name: Misao
source: A girl who grew up in the mansion and wasn't raised by anyone. Due to this, she is very childlike and extremely innocent, even to the point she doesn't know about sex. An outspoken, athletic tomboy, she likes to tease Shin'ichi, especially when he persists in trying to escape the mansion.
